title: Getting Started With rExpertQuery
text: Expery Query (https://owapps.epa.gov/expertquery/attains/tmdl) empowers users access surface water quality data Assessment TMDL Tracking Implementation System (ATTAINS), encompassing Assessment decisions (Clean Water Act Sections 303(d), 305(b), 106) Action data like Total Maximum Daily Loads (TMDLs), Advance Restoration Plans (ARPs), Protection Approaches. tool supports querying downloading data within across organizations (states tribes), querying data within EPA region nutrient TMDLs nationally. also allows users download national ATTAINS data extracts. rExpertQuery takes step functions facilitate querying Expert Query web services R functions allow user import resulting data sets directly R detailed review analysis. crucial aware certain complexities inherent data querying process. Users cautioned direct comparisons states due differences water quality standards assessment methodologies. Expert Query facilitates data querying, lacks built-summary capabilities. Users encouraged download summarize data, use caution relying row counts, duplicate entries may occur. complexity arises multiple tables many--many relationships. Future vignettes functions may provide examples summarize Expert Query data.

title: Getting Started With rExpertQuery
text: EQ_Actions() queries ATTAINS Actions data variety user supplied parameters. example, might like run relatively simple query return data Region 4 Actions included Measures. query returns 16,370 results, ’ll review small random subset data table just get idea results look like: might also want create specific query. example, might want find Actions Missouri issued EPA completion dates 2000-01-01 2020-12-31. detailed query returns smaller data set, data table shows results query
code: # query Actions from Region 4 that are included in Measures R4_actions_in_meas <- rExpertQuery::EQ_Actions(api_key = testkey, region = 4, in_meas = "Yes") # create random subset of R4 query results R4_subset <- R4_actions_in_meas %>%   dplyr::slice_sample(n = 20)  # create data tab;e DT::datatable(R4_subset, options = list(pageLength = 2, scrollX = TRUE)) # query Actions for Missouri Actions with action agency "EPA" and parameter group "PATHOGENS" MO_epa <- rExpertQuery::EQ_Actions(   api_key = testkey, statecode = "MO",   act_agency = "EPA",   param_group = "PATHOGENS",   comp_date_start = "2000-01-01",   comp_date_end = "2020-12-31" ) ## [1] "EQ_Actions: The current query will return 4 rows." # view MO results DT::datatable(MO_epa, options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))

title: Getting Started With rExpertQuery
text: EQ_Actions() queries ATTAINS Actions Documents data user supplied parameters. One unique features can search documents keyword phrase. example, might want find Actions Documents contained keyword “nutrients”. query yields 17,632 results. well providing Action Document Name results, EQ_Actions() also returns column “actionDocumentUrl” containg URL link document. Becaue query yields many results, ’ll take look smaller subset data table understand structure results. can also query typical parameters like organization name (org_name), EPA region (region) , action type (act_type). example demonstrates using function search 4B Restoration Approach documents Pennsylvania. 17 4B Restoration Approach documents Pennsylvania, can review table . Actions Document Example, actionDocumentUrl column contains link document.
code: # Actions Documents containing "nutrient" Nutrient_docs <- rExpertQuery::EQ_ActionsDocuments(   doc_query = "nutrient",   api_key = testkey ) ## [1] "EQ_ActionDocuments: The current query will return 17,632 rows." Nutrient_docs_subset <- Nutrient_docs %>%   dplyr::slice_sample(n = 20)  DT::datatable(Nutrient_docs_subset, options = list(pageLength = 5, scrollX = TRUE), escape = FALSE) PA_4B <- rExpertQuery::EQ_ActionsDocuments(   statecode = "PA", act_type = "4B Restoration Approach",   api = testkey ) ## [1] "EQ_ActionDocuments: The current query will return 14 rows." PA_4B_subset <- PA_4B %>%   dplyr::slice_sample(n = 20)  DT::datatable(PA_4B_subset, options = list(pageLength = 5, scrollX = TRUE), escape = FALSE)

title: Getting Started With rExpertQuery
text: EQ_Assessments() queries ATTAINS Assessments data. many use cases, querying Assessments single organization state desirable. next example shows query single state use class latest cycle. 20,254 results basic latest cycle Kentucky query. also possible design specific assessment queries. example, might want narrow results show causes use class one region. code demonstrates querying EPA Region 3 Assessments ECOLOGICAL_USE group least one parameter status “Cause”. data table shows random sample results Region 3 Query.

R3_ecological_subset <- R3_ecological %>%   dplyr::slice_sample(n = 20)  DT::datatable(R3_ecological_subset, options = list(pageLength = 5, scrollX = TRUE), escape = FALSE)

title: R Tools for Expert Query
text: ten exported functions rExpertQuery. first eight allow users query ATTAINS data via Expert Query web services (https://owapps.epa.gov/expertquery/api-documentation). : EQ_Actions() - queries returns ATTAINS actions data EQ_ActionsDocuments() - queries returns ATTAINS Actions Documents, including keyword search EQ_Assessments() - queries returns ATTAINS Assessments EQ_AssessmentUnits() - queries returns ATTAINS Assessment Units (default Active AUs) EQ_AUsMLs() - queries returns ATTAINS Assessment Units Monitoring Location data EQ_CatchCorr() - queries returns ATTAINS Catchment Correspondence data (memory intensive) EQ_Sources() - queries returns ATTAINS Sources data EQ_TMDLs() - queries returns ATTAINS TMDL data additional function allows users download Expert Query National Extracts ATTAINS data (https://owapps.epa.gov/expertquery/national-downloads) updated weekly. function used national data desired query designed one previous eight functions exceed Expert Query web services limit one millions rows. function : EQ_NationalExtract() - returns national extract Actions, Assessments, Assessment Units, Assessment Units Monitoring Locations, Catchment Correspondence, Sources, TMDLS based user selection tenth function relies ATTAINS web services (https://www.epa.gov/waterdata/-access--use-attains-web-services) provide allowable domain values rExpertQuery parameters: EQ_DomainValues - returns domain values rExpertQuery function params information query params function examples see:

title: Query and return ATTAINS Actions data via Expert Query web services — EQ_Actions
text: api_key Character string. Users must supply unique api key access Expert Query web services. obtain api, submit form : https://owapps.epa.gov/expertquery/api-key-signup act_agency Character string. Denotes agency establishing/issuing action associated Assessment. Options "State", "Tribe", "EPA". Default = NULL. act_id Character string. Unique Identifier Action associated Assessment used track Action entered (corresponding information associated documents) ATTAINS, associated name. Default = NULL act_name Character string. name associated action.Default = NULL. act_type Character string. Identifies type Action associated Action. Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues(act_type).Default = NULL au_name Character string. name assigned Assessment Unit Organization. Default = NULL. auid Character string. unique identifier assigned Assessment Unit Organization. Default = NULL. comp_date_end Character string. ending date date range Action planned completed. Usually refers date TMDL Action date initially submitted EPA. Format "YYYY-MM-DD". Default = NULL. comp_date_start Character string. starting date date range Action planned completed. Usually refers date TMDL Action date initially submitted EPA. Format "YYYY-MM-DD". Default = NULL. fisc_year_end Character string. ending year date range fiscal years particular action, program, project initiated established. Format "YYYY". Default = NULL. fisc_year_start Character string. starting year date range fiscal years particular action, program, project initiated established. Format "YYYY". Default = NULL. in_meas Character string. EPA can determine whether Action count towards 303(d) measures. Draft Actions get partial credit finalized Actions get full cred. default, measures count towards measures unless EPA changes flag specific action. Options "Yes" "". Default = NULL. indian_country Character string. Indicates water either wholly partially Indian country. Options "Yes" "". Default = NULL. org_id Character string. unique identifier assigned Organization. Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues("org_id"). Default = NULL. org_name Character string. unique name assigned Organization. Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues("org_name"). Default = NULL. param_name name characteristic  monitored assessed. Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues("param_name"). Default = NULL. param_group Character string. collection related Parameters. Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues("param_attain"). Default = NULL. region Numeric (integer). Integer 1 10 identify EPA region interest. See https://www.epa.gov/aboutepa/regional--geographic-offices options. Default = NULL. statecode Character string. FIPS state alpha code identifies state (e.g. statecode = "DE" Delaware). See https://www.waterqualitydata.us/Codes/statecode options. water_type Character string. Assessment Unit must least one water type, may multiple water types. Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues("water_type"). Default = NULL.

title: Query and return ATTAINS TMDL data via Expert Query web services — EQ_TMDLs
text: api_key Character string. Users must supply unique api key access Expert Query web services. obtain api, submit form : https://owapps.epa.gov/expertquery/api-key-signup act_agency Character string. Denotes agency establishing/issuing action associated Assessment. Options "state", "tribe", "epa". Default = NULL. act_id Character string. Unique Identifier Action associated Assessment used track Action entered (corresponding information associated documents) ATTAINS, associated name. Default = NULL. act_name Character string. name associated action.Default = NULL. au_name Character string. name assigned Assessment Unit Organization. Default = NULL. auid Character string. unique identifier assigned Assessment Unit Organization. Default = NULL. comp_date_end Character string. ending date date range Action planned completed. Usually refers date TMDL Action date initially submitted EPA. Format "YYYY-MM-DD". Default = NULL. comp_date_start Character string. starting date date range Action planned completed. Usually refers date TMDL Action date initially submitted EPA. Format "YYYY-MM-DD". Default = NULL. fisc_year_end Character string. ending year date range fiscal years particular action, program, project initiated established. Format "YYYY". Default = NULL. fisc_year_start Character string. starting year date range fiscal years particular action, program, project initiated established. Format "YYYY". Default = NULL. in_meas Character string. EPA can determine whether Action count towards 303(d) measures. Draft Actions get partial credit finalized Actions get full cred. default, measures count towards measures unless EPA changes flag specific action. Options "Yes" "". Default = NULL. indian_country Character string. Indicates water either wholly partially Indian country. Options "Yes" "". Default = NULL. org_id Character string. unique identifier assigned Organization. Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues("org_id"). Default = NULL. org_name Character string. unique name assigned Organization. Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues("org_name"). Default = NULL. region Numeric (integer). Integer 1 10 identify EPA region interest. See https://www.epa.gov/aboutepa/regional--geographic-offices options. Default = NULL. statecode Character string. FIPS state alpha code identifies state (e.g. statecode = "DE" Delaware). See https://www.waterqualitydata.us/Codes/statecode options. Default = NULL. tmdl_date_end Character string. correspond ending date date range EPA approved official final TMDL submitted (date approval letter). Format "YYYY-MM-DD". Default = NULL. tmdl_date_start Character string. correspond starting date date range EPA approved official final TMDL submitted (date approval letter). Format "YYYY-MM-DD". Default = NULL. water_type Character string. Assessment Unit must least one water type, may multiple water types. Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues("water_type"). Default = NULL. ad_param Character string. context TMDL, Addressed Parameters refer associated parameters (parameters identified causes impairment Section 303(d) list later identified TMDL process) addressed pollutant TMDL. Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues("ad_param"). Default = NULL. ad_param_group Character string. Groups Addressed Parameters. Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues("ad_param_group").Default = NULL. mos_exp Character string. Refers Explicit Margin Safety Associated Pollutant identified TMDL. Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues("mos_exp"). Default = NULL. mos_imp Character string. Refers Implicit Margin Safety Associated Pollutant identified TMDL. Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues("mos_imp"). Default = NULL. npdes_id Character string. Identification numbers NPDES permits within waterbody associated TMDL pollutant. Default = NULL. other_id Character string. Alternative code identifying TMDL Report (example state assigned identifier different ID Action ID). Default = NULL. pollutant Character string. Indicates Pollutant TMDL load calculated. Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues("pollutant"). Default = NULL. poll_group Character string. Indicates group Pollutant belongs . Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues("poll_group"). Default = NULL. source_type Character string. Indicates Source breakdown TMDL. Options "Nonpoint source", "", "Point source", "Unknown". Default = NULL.
